description: CAD_to_OpenMC is a Python package that converts STEP geometry from CAD tools to triangulated HDF5 geometry for particle-transport simulation. The JOSS article describes the STEP-to-DAGMC workflow, and the current own README names OpenMC and the target h5m format. The paper-linked openmsr repository says development moved to the current united-neux repository, which reports MIT. Spatial coverage is the user-supplied component or facility design; temporal coverage comes from a separate transport or operating scenario. The converter can help prepare reactor or shielding geometry for the catalogue model-openmc. A caveat is that mesh conversion does not verify material assignments, geometry fidelity or radiation-transport results. Users must check surfaces and solver compatibility. No catalogue or first-review record covers this separate converter. The article and both repository trails were read without converting CAD files or downloading a solver.
name: CAD_to_OpenMC geometry converter
notes: G5 G5-0765. Software checked through metadata and documentation, without installation or execution. Geographic scope follows the documented application or software portability; it does not imply validation throughout that area.
